text:
sara: Heads-up — scheduling a staged traffic priming from EU -> APAC tomorrow 2026-03-18 09:00 UTC. Plan: 10% increments every 10m, smoke checks at each step, total ~90m. TTL will be reduced ahead of time to 60s. Who's taking primary smoke & rollback?

sam: I can own the deploy window and watch serving metrics (p50/p95, error rate). I’ll be available 08:50–11:30 UTC. Ping me for immediate rollbacks. :thumbsup:

liam: I’ll run APAC-origin smoke tests and validate request routing from major regions. Test script is `scripts/smoke/apac_health.sh` — will post outputs here.

jen: I’ll do canary log sampling and tracing checks (span errors, lat spikes). Add me for slack pings. Also, confirm alert thresholds: error_rate > 0.5% OR latency p95 > 500ms triggers rollback?

sara: yes, jen — those are the thresholds. Also watch model-inference queue depth; if it grows > 3x steady-state for > 2 intervals, abort and rollback.

carla: ops-bot will handle the DNS TTL flip at 08:45 UTC. I’ll prepare a quick runbook for rollback knobs.

ops-bot: scheduled action: reduce DNS TTL for `*.edge.redwood` to 60s at 2026-03-18T08:45:00Z (ticket #INC-flag-none).

deploy-bot: deployment window reserved in calendar: 2026-03-18 09:00–10:45 UTC. Canary tags: eu-edge-v2 -> eu-edge-v3.

liam: smoke checklist (short):
1) `curl -I https://edge.eu.redwood/api/health` — expect 200 and `x-rr-region: eu` when at 10%
2) run `k6` quick load (100 concurrent, 30s) against canary host
3) check traces for invocation errors (>1% fail)
I’ll post a small snippet after first step.

liam: first check after 10% shift:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-rr-region: apac
x-edge-version: eu-edge-v3
uptime: 00:12:34
```
looks ok from APAC vantage.

sam: infra metrics steady. p50 42ms, p95 181ms, error_rate 0.08%. No queue surge. Proceeding to next 10% in 10m.

jen: tracing sampled — a couple of transient timeouts at 10% but under threshold. continuing.

carla: rollback plan summary:
- immediate: revert weight in Traffic Manager (weighted DNS) to previous distribution (manual step)
- secondary: change routed region fallback to global-edge-standby
- last resort: re-run deployment to pin older image and invalidate KV caches
Estimated RTO for immediate revert: <3 minutes assuming TTL respected.

sara: who runs the manual DNS weight revert if we need it?

sam: I will execute revert and post confirmation. jen to validate traces, liam to validate routing.

jen: acknowledged. I’ll monitor and call rollback if threshold crossed.

liam: small note — make sure autoscaler tails are disabled for this window to avoid instance churn affecting metrics. Sam, can you confirm?

sam: confirmed — autoscaler scale-in suppressed from 08:45–11:00 UTC.

carla: preflight checklist for 08:30:
- update runbook in Confluence (link)
- confirm on-call pages for NA/EU/APAC
- ensure TTL set to 60s at 08:45 (ops-bot will post)
- create temp alert channels: #deploy-eu-apac-priming

sara: final call: thumbs? If no objections, we go tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

sam: :thumbsup:

liam: :thumbsup:

jen: :thumbsup:

carla: :thumbsup:

ops-bot: reminder will be posted 30m before TTL change and 10m before traffic start.

sara: thanks team — I’ll post a short status update during each step. If anyone can't make the window, tell me now.

jen: I’m good.

sam: good.

carla: all set.

liam: ready.

sara: closing thread — see you in #deploy-eu-apac-priming tomorrow.
